notes: Kernel continuation branch kernel/lean434-study-hardening audited the checked-in final Lean 4.34 C++ kernel and Lean4Lean study trees. The existing full-std.log failure was pre-replay JavaScript syntax corruption in scripts/module-stream-oracle.mjs, not kernel-semantic evidence; commit 3dda273 repairs it and commit 50bff93 adds runner syntax checks. full-Std-environment-replay remains open until a fresh canonical replay succeeds.
Final-4.34 native-reduction correction is committed but awaits the refreshed CI/differential run before being promoted into the verified gate list.

Lean 4.34 final alignment correction: upstream commit 2a7175c74ba17b160299accd7e6ea6984d7ea86f removed Lean.reduceBool/Lean.reduceNat, ofReduceBool/ofReduceNat, Lean.trustCompiler, and all in-kernel native compiler-IR reduction. pskernel removed NativeEvaluator/native-reduction special handling and retired the native-IR compatibility gate.

Deep-expression robustness hardening keeps 97/97 direct tests and 170/170 Arena correctness green: hasMVar, lift, and instantiate now use explicit traversal stacks, and isolated heavy oracle workers use a larger JavaScript stack while the kernel maxRecDepth limit remains authoritative.

Lean Kernel Arena static correctness sweep passes 170/170 non-performance cases after two fixes: projection inference now checks the projected structure expression (rejecting the proj-of-prop false proof), and lean4export intern tables accept valid sparse/out-of-order IDs while still rejecting duplicates. Arena performance cases remain a separate optimization gate.

Canonical one-pass module-order Full Std replay is now the preferred exhaustive completion gate. Dependency-closure batching is retained as diagnostic tooling for isolating failures, not as the release definition.

Expanded soundness baseline passes 95/95 direct TypeScript tests plus 21 expected-success and 1 expected-rejection official Lean 4.34 kernel regression files. New direct invariants explicitly reject expression metavariables, universe metavariables, and duplicate mutual-inductive names transactionally.

Official Lean 4.34 definitional-equality differential previously passed 42/42 including two pre-final native-reduction cases; the final-4.34 matrix removes those obsolete cases and must be re-run. The expansion covers every dedicated Nat reducer (sub/mul/pow/gcd/mod/div/land/lor/xor/shiftLeft/shiftRight/beq/ble), let-under-binder substitution, dependent Subtype structure eta, and K-like Eq.rec iota reduction.
Final Lean 4.34 removed the deprecated in-kernel native-reduction declarations and compiler-IR hooks; pskernel no longer models them as kernel operations.

GitHub repository dwijayuda/pskernel is now the persistent source of truth. Fast TypeScript CI is green, the Lean 4.34 fixture generator is reproducible on GitHub Actions, the official defeq differential is 26/26, and the adversarial oracle is 21 expected-success + 1 expected-rejection kernel regression cases.

Real Lean.Data.PersistentHashMap dependency-closure roots replay passes: 12,885 records, 10,377 expressions, 298 declaration records, and exactly 397 admitted/generated constants. This gate adds nested Entry/Node families, BEq/Hashable-parameterized structures, collision-node handling, and insert/find/contains recursion without additional kernel changes.

Real Lean.Data.PersistentArray dependency-closure roots replay passes: 85,105 records, 74,170 expressions, 1,440 declaration records, and exactly 1,633 admitted/generated constants. The corpus exposed and fixed Lean 4.34 nested-inductive parameter BinderInfo preservation: constructor parameters are recreated per constructor during preprocessing and again during restoration, with canonical nested parameters rebased to the fresh restoration locals.

Adversarial oracle now passes 13/13 pinned Lean 4.34 kernel regression files, adding kernel1/kernel2 native-large-value behavior, normalized-Prop projection safety, deterministic maxRecDepth failure, kernel-error follow-up behavior, and kernel-error backtracking; the TS suite now directly mirrors deterministic maxRecDepth rejection/success as well.

Official Lean 4.34 defeq differential now passes 24/24 paired cases using the full Init.Prelude replay environment, adding unit-like equality, Unicode String expansion, Quot.lift iota, max/imax normalization, deeper Nat recursor reduction, Bool reduction, and additional negative cases.

lean4export intern tables now use dense monotonic arrays rather than Map<number,...>; the full 463,440-record RBMap replay remains exact while peak RSS drops further to ~927 MiB, and sparse/out-of-order indices fail closed.

Large-corpus replay can now consume decompressed NDJSON incrementally through replayLine()/finish(); full Lean.Data.RBMap remains 463,440 records / 11,223 constants while peak RSS drops from ~1.14 GiB to ~0.94 GiB with essentially unchanged runtime.

Full imported Lean.Data.RBMap environment replay passes end-to-end after identity-keyed cache hardening: 463,440 records, 391,273 expressions, 10,573 declaration records, and exactly 11,223 admitted/generated constants. The compressed 4.0 MiB fixture is a separate large corpus gate so normal development loops remain bounded.

Kernel memo caches now use compact expression identity IDs rather than recursively serialized exprKey strings. On the same fixtures this reduced ByteSlice replay from 20.58s/~911MB RSS to 6.92s/~593MB and Init.Prelude from 7.00s/~267MB to 1.33s/~113MB, while all semantic/oracle gates remained green.

With identity-keyed caches, the complete imported Lean.Data.RBMap environment replays successfully: 463,440 records, 391,273 expressions, 10,573 declaration records, 11,223 constants in 25.92s. This large gate is being kept separate from short CI loops.

Lean 4.34 defeq-cache hardening is now paired with the official kernel_is_def_eq_equiv_manager_1/2 regressions. The TS KernelState has an explicit regression that successful algorithmic defeq pairs remain pair-local and are never transitively closed.

Adversarial soundness baseline is green: 86/86 TS tests plus 5/5 pinned Lean 4.34 kernel regression files covering projection index truncation, wrong-structure projection reduction, reserved _nested injection, duplicate mutual names, and imax-normalized Prop elimination.

Real Lean.Data.RBMap dependency-closure roots replay passes: 41,107 records, 35,396 expressions, 633 declaration records, and 743 admitted/generated constants. This is the first bounded Lean.* corpus gate and covers dependent RBNode fields, folds, balancing/insertion, and well-founded appendTrees recursion.

A generic DependencyExport.lean now replaces one-off exporter growth for new corpus probes. It has explicit Lean-4.34 semantic dependencies for primitive recognizers (notably Nat.div/Nat.mod generated fuel helpers and reflected condition support), preventing syntactic dependency closure from omitting trusted-kernel prerequisites.

Real Std.Data.ByteSlice dependency-closure roots replay passes: 90,125 records, 79,106 expressions, 1,442 declaration records, and 1,630 admitted/generated constants. This third bounded Std corpus stresses UInt8/ByteArray, Fin-indexed access, proof-carrying slice bounds, structure projections, and recursive slice/contains code.

Real Std.Sat.CNF.Basic dependency-closure roots replay passes: 11,338 records, 9,183 expressions, 275 declaration records, and 366 admitted/generated constants. This second bounded Std corpus adds structures, arrays/lists, Bool evaluation, proposition-valued Sat/Unsat predicates, and clause/formula variable membership machinery without overlapping the parser control-flow profile.

Expanded real Std.Internal.Parsec.Basic dependency-closure replay passes: 23,239 records, 18,921 expressions, 515 declaration records, and 646 admitted/generated constants. The slice covers Error/ParseResult inductives, the Parsec abstraction, Input typeclass, higher-order bind/tryCatch, Alternative control flow, EOF/lookahead combinators, partial manyCore recursion, and String/Char recursion through manyCharsCore.

Full dependency-aware Init.Prelude corpus replay passes end-to-end: 70,484 records, 60,035 expressions, 2,038 declaration records, and exactly 2,324 admitted constants. Real corpus replay exposed and fixed Lean.Syntax auxiliary recursor appendIndexAfter naming, Quot Eq universe-parameter alpha-equivalence, and exact Quot.lift/Quot.ind binder/de-Bruijn layouts.

Expanded official Lean 4.34 defeq differential gate passes 14/14 cases, adding universe max normalization, definition delta, opaque non-delta, projection lazy-delta, and Nat recursor iota. String-literal differential remains deferred until the replay environment includes String.

Official Lean 4.34 differential defeq baseline passes 9/9 paired cases (beta, zeta, Nat reduction, function eta, proof irrelevance, structure eta, and negative inequality/eta cases). This gate exposed and fixed a real proof-irrelevance bug plus stale synthetic Eq-universe fixtures.

Real Lean 4.34 primitive dependency closure replays completely: 14,702 records, 12,125 expressions, 325 declaration records, and 390 admitted/generated constants. Nat.mod, Nat.div, Nat.gcd, and Nat.bitwise are all admitted through production recognizers.

Real replay found and fixed compatibility issues rather than bypassing them: inductive type-annotation consumption, primitive type comparison across mdata, LocalContext fresh-ID collisions, Eq/ite universe levels in condition certificates, and Lean private Name.num construction for Nat.bitwise well-founded proof.
Primitive recognizers implemented: Nat.add/pred/sub/mul/pow/beq/ble/land/lor/xor/shiftLeft/shiftRight, Char.ofNat, String.ofList.
lean4export 3.1.0 replay boundary is version-pinned and reconstructs checked declarations rather than trusting generated metadata.
No full Lean compatibility claim until differential and corpus gates pass.

Lean 4.34-style defeq search now includes Nat offset comparison, projection-aware lazy delta, structure eta, unit-like equality, proof irrelevance, and pair-cache hardening; string literal/native reduction parity remains open.
String literal definitional equality now follows Lean 4.34 String.ofList/List Char/Char.ofNat constructor expansion, including non-BMP Unicode code points.
Projection defeq now follows Lean 4.34 lazy-delta field comparison; equal projected fields can compare equal even when other structure fields differ.
Corrected a compatibility bug found by source audit: Lean 4.34 theorems are opaque to delta reduction; only definitions unfold.
Mutual definition admission now matches the Lean 4.34 block rules for unsafe/partial declarations and commits transactionally.
lean4export 3.1.0 flattened unsafe/partial mutual definitions are reconstructed from DefinitionVal.all metadata and admitted through the real mutual-definition gate; incomplete groups fail closed.
Projection typing now enforces Lean 4.34 proof irrelevance: non-Prop fields cannot be projected from Prop-valued structures; fully-applied structure arity is also checked.

Nat literal sizing and Nat.pow/Nat.shiftLeft count guards now match Lean 4.34 core defaults: 128 MiB explicit trusted-core limit and 32-bit unsigned counts; runtime environment overrides remain outside the trusted core.
Recursor reduction now applies Lean 4.34 non-recursive-structure eta conversion before rule selection; projection WHNF reuses the constructor-aware projection reducer.
Recursor reduction now converts String literals through the same String.ofList/List Char constructor path used by Lean 4.34 before computation-rule selection.
Historical Lean.reduceBool/Lean.reduceNat special handling has been removed to match final Lean 4.34, where those declarations no longer exist.

WellFounded.Nat.fix/fix.go structural certification now validates both the outer fixpoint wrapper and the inner Nat.rec predecessor-fuel equation; complex primitive equations themselves remain fail-closed.

Well-founded primitive Probe infrastructure now derives the induction-hypothesis domain and validates defining equations independently from fixpoint scaffolding; outer-only and full certificates are separated to prevent accidental overclaiming.

Ordinary inductive admission now propagates Lean 4.34 safe/unsafe checking mode through headers, constructors, recursor synthesis, and defensive recursor checks; unsafe inductives skip positivity while their generated constants remain unsafe.
Nested-inductive restoration hardening now uses the declaration safety mode and each restored recursor's universe parameters, matching the 4.34 recheck boundary.
Final Lean 4.34 lazy defeq has no native-reduction hook; pskernel now follows Nat reduction directly with ordinary lazy-delta machinery.
Projection-headed lazy unfolding uses full projection WHNF, and projection indices are restricted to integral uint32 values.

Lean 4.34 eagerReduce mode is now implemented: application-argument type checking enables eager Nat/reflection defeq even when free variables occur syntactically; regression coverage verifies the mode is scoped to eagerReduce arguments.

Boolean primitive condition certification now checks the Lean-style Bool.decEq/ite boundary operationally: specialized Nat ite must typecheck and reduce to the true/false branch correctly; a swapped implementation is rejected.

Nat.gcd recognizer is wired through exact type, bool condition, well-founded skeleton, base equation, and structural recursive-target certification; it remains an open compatibility gate until tested against an actual elaborated Lean 4.34 candidate.
Lean 4.34 cheap_rec and cheap_proj WHNF controls are modeled separately; initial defeq can avoid delta-reducing recursor majors while preserving cheap projection behavior.

whnfCore now has a dedicated Lean 4.34 cache: normal calls cache full core WHNF results, cheap modes never populate it, and direct recursor/quotient iota preserves Lean's early-return cache boundary; explicit regression added.
Nat ≤ condition certification now checks Nat.decLe against the Lean 4.34 Nat.ble reflection model and independently validates dependent-if computation; branch construction uses binder-safe lifting.
Nat = condition certification now reconstructs the Lean 4.34 dependent Nat.decEq/Nat.beq model with Bool.rec and equality evidence; an opaque same-typed decider is rejected.

Nat.mod and Nat.div now use a shared fuel-recursion recognizer: exact generated go signature, certified Nat ≤ condition, public wrapper equation, recursive fuel-step equation, and decrease-proof typing. Bounded recursor-style positive fixtures plus malicious rules prevent timeout-prone self-reference tests.

A locally bootstrapped Lean 4.34.0 Release stage1 toolchain is now an executable oracle; scripts/official-oracle.mjs pins the exact version and requires leanchecker --fresh Init.Prelude to pass. This gate is kept separate from npm run check because the binary is an external build artifact.

Official Lean 4.34 leanchecker gate now replays Init.Prelude plus the real Div.Basic, Gcd, and Bitwise.Basic modules from fresh environments, keeping the hard primitive source shapes in the external oracle contract.
Nat equality condition certification now includes independent ordinary ite and proof-carrying dite control-flow checks, matching the control surface consumed by Lean 4.34 Nat.bitwise recognition.

Lean 4.34 recursor synthesis now ports the kernel infer_implicit(rec_ty, true) pass, including strict loose-bound-variable dependency/transitivity checks; a real MiniNat recursor exposed the missing motive implicitness.

Real Lean 4.34 end-to-end replay gate now covers an axiom, theorem, recursive MiniNat inductive with generated constructors/recursor, and an ordinary definition. The TS kernel exactly regenerates and compares exported inductive/recursor metadata rather than trusting it.

Lean Name compatibility now includes appendAfter/appendIndexAfter semantics used by the kernel. Fresh recursor elimination universes use u_1/u_2-style final-component suffixes, not hierarchical u.1 names.

Real Lean 4.34 replay fixture now includes universe-polymorphic MiniList α and singleton in addition to MiniNat; exact generated recursor metadata, universe parameter ordering, and inferred implicit binders match the official .olean environment.

Real Lean 4.34 replay fixture now includes indexed MiniVec α : MiniNat → Type u. The TS kernel exactly reproduces numParams/numIndices, indexed motive/recursor metadata, constructor rules, and accepts a vecOne definition over the generated indexed family.
